retest with next version of ubuntu

And started cleaning up bug workarounds, so we test more stuff and disable fewer tests. Still more todo. Added a few TSAN suppressions.

Just noticed that qCompiler_SanitizerDoubleLockWithConditionVariables_Buggy appears to be broken on Ubuntu 20.04 when using g++-10, so instead of checking by OS, will define this by gcc version==10 or 11 (for now - WAG).

- and otherwise simplicatiion - new configure flag --include-default-TSAN_OPTIONS {true/false} - and have configure automatically add TSAN_OPTIONS for ThreadSanitizerSuppressions.supp OR ThreadSanitizerSuppressions_qCompiler_SanitizerDoubleLockWithConditionVariables_Buggy.supp as appriopriuate - and appearntly appropriate anytime using g++10 or 11 - or at least added case of on Ubuntu 20.04 (really only tested needed for TSAN, but probably also for valgrind)
Had to add to the TSAN_OPTIONS

It appears this same bug exists on Ubuntu 22.04 and g++-11.2

This is SO broken - I just disabled TSAN when this flag is set in the configure --only-if-compiler - flag is passed, so we just do see this anymore. And I did add improved regtest RegressionTest24_qCompiler_SanitizerDoubleLockWithConditionVariables_Buggy_
Also broken on Ubuntu 20.04 due to change in what compilers we install there now. This is a hint its issue with compiler not OS version (more).
But unclear when thnis makes it into ubuntu.
does appear broken on g++ on Ubuntu 22.04, but appears FIXED on Ubuntu 24.04 g++ (note diff versions of g++) - ONLY testing TSAN now since helgrind support abandoned.
Read of size 4 at 0x7ffe42ef193c by thread T5:
Previous write of size 4 at 0x7ffe42ef193c by thread T4:
Location is stack of main thread.
Thread T5 (tid=1916207, running) created by main thread at:
Thread T4 (tid=1916206, running) created by main thread at:
consists of two loops using a single WaitableEvent to Set/Wait(), and Wait autoresets - all modifications of the fTriggered flag take place inside a lock.
And so between Set/Wait there must be a lock/unlock of that mutex.
So pretty sure this is not a data race.
